h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhimavaram

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhimavaram

items.pText: Bhimavaram is a town in the Godavari delta in West Godavari district, Andhra Pradesh, surrounded by paddy fields, canals and aquaculture ponds. Water is never far away, and the air is humid for most of the year. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, colleges, housing layouts and parks in Bhimavaram at our Vasai factory, about 960 km away, and sends it by road.

Delta land often has a high water table, so ground that looks dry in March can turn soggy by August. That affects the base more than the equipment itself. Our galvanised posts and roto-moulded plastic parts handle humidity without rusting. What needs care is the footing and the surface under the play area. Before we suggest an installation method, we ask whether water stands on your ground after heavy rain, and for how long.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Drainage and flooring on delta ground

c: Raise the play area with compacted fill and build in a slope to a drain or canal edge. Grout the posts into concrete footings set above the wettest level of the ground.

Rubber flooring on a firm base sheds water quickly and dries soon after rain, which soil and grass do not. In very humid weather, wipe slides before use, since condensation can make them slippery in the morning. A

items.q: Can you install playground equipment where the water table is high?
items.a: Yes. We suggest raising the play area, grouting posts into concrete above the wettest level, and laying rubber flooring with a drainage slope. Site photos after rain help us plan this.
No. Roto-moulded plastic does not rust or rot in humid weather. Galvanised posts are also corrosion-resistant. Wipe surfaces in the morning to clear condensation.

items.q: Do you deliver to the Godavari delta towns?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory by road and install it in Bhimavaram and nearby towns with our team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh.
